instruction.name: xvffint.d.l
instruction.description: Convert signed 64-bit integer elements in `a` to double-precision floating point numbers.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvffint.d.l $xr0, $xr8; xvffint.d.l $xr1, $xr9; xvffint.d.l $xr2, $xr10; xvffint.d.l $xr3, $xr11; xvffint.d.l $xr4, $xr12; xvffint.d.l $xr5, $xr13; xvffint.d.l $xr6, $xr14; xvffint.d.l $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvffint.d.l $xr0, $xr8; xvffint.d.l $xr1, $xr9; xvffint.d.l $xr2, $xr10; xvffint.d.l $xr3, $xr11; xvffint.d.l $xr4, $xr12; xvffint.d.l $xr5, $xr13; xvffint.d.l $xr6, $xr14; xvffint.d.l $xr7, $xr15'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
